verdict.rationale: Evidence shows ingestion (.remember), retrieval (.recall), enrichment (.improve) and deletion (.forget) operations, plus CLI 'push' to Cognee Cloud and a 'report' command that summarizes a graph, but nothing documents an explicit export/dump command or machine-readable export format for migrating memory data out of Cognee to another system. The openapi probe also failed (404), and no docs describe importing exported data elsewhere, so portability is unevidenced despite the product being open-source and self-hostable.
